{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
df_control_moderate = df_dedup[
    (df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & 
    (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')
]

# Compute response fraction
n_total = len(df_control_moderate)
n_responded = df_control_moderate['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

print(f"Total patients in control arm with moderate severity (after deduplication): {n_total}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded:.4f}")"}
